format_probe_sampling: First 512 rows of first/middle/last distinct row groups; deterministic nonrandom format sample, not prevalence or negative classification. Every remaining fixed-schema column is selected regardless of sensitive keywords.

assignee_full_probe.comparison: exact string equality; no trim, case folding, Unicode normalization, or account validity verification

count_unit: Format observations are source cells; account lookup cells are a separate support denominator. Nested key/leaf counts are occurrences within sampled JSON, not people, credentials, or log changes.

fenced_json_followup.coverage_note: Revisits the same first 512 rows of every remaining string field; these are not additional unique sampled cells. Only explicit json/JSON triple-backtick Markdown blocks; no patch line stripping or arbitrary payload extraction.

findings.title_zh: 可直接新增 assignee 精确账户引用映射
findings.minimum_implementation: Add only (aidev, pr_timeline, assignee) as the existing exact frozen account-login join role. Persist matched / null / empty / invalid / unmatched ranges separately; unmatched values keep category/subtype null. Reuse lookup coverage and fingerprint checks; no new general id/name rule.
findings.semantic_limits: A GitHub account may be a person, bot, organization, or unresolved identity. Exact reference membership proves only dataset linkage, not privacy sensitivity, ownership or leakage.

findings.title_zh: 明确 JSON 围栏适合有界结构解码，但尚无新增敏感类型证据
findings.minimum_implementation: If decoded-content support is added, begin with explicit JSON fences, strict JSON (reject duplicate keys and nonstandard constants), at most two encoded layers, bounded input/nodes/depth. Record representation origin and outer source cell; Unicode-decoded offsets are not interchangeable with raw-source offsets. Keep parsing failures, over-budget cells and unrecognized keys unresolved. Do not run this as a prerequisite filter for Git history tracing.
findings.semantic_limits: location is ambiguous and may denote a code/config/resource location. Nonempty string shape does not establish geography, a person link, coordinates, or precise location. These blocks remain content carriers and unclassified structure.

findings.title_zh: 其余固定 schema 未提供新的明确联系、位置或认证字段
findings.minimum_implementation: Keep these columns in field-level coverage and existing content review, grouped by carrier / resource reference / metadata or aggregate. Do not map repository full_name or id, followers/following counts, dates, code paths, or public repository URLs to person names, credentials, private paths or new sensitive types based on field words alone.
findings.semantic_limits: The 512-row-per-table probe is deterministic and not representative; zero JSON/shape hits are not absence evidence. Markdown, code, nested strings, arbitrary encodings and long cells still need bounded follow-up or manual review.
